issues.description: PersonResource#getAllPersons has an inconsistent return type between template and solution: the template declares ResponseEntity<List<Person>> while the solution declares ResponseEntity<Set<Person>> but still returns personService.getAll() which has signature List<Person>. This mismatch (List vs Set) is structural and will cause compilation/type errors and confusion about the intended API return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API return type consistent. Either change PersonResource#getAllPersons to return ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (matching PersonService#getAll()) or change PersonService#getAll() to return a Set<Person> and update its implementation accordingly. Ensure both template and solution use the same collection type for the /persons endpoint to avoid compilation errors and student confusion.
